decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. Utilizing cards like Architects of Will, Grief, and Shardless Agent to manipulate the opponent's hand and board while setting up for the combo. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By cycling through the deck and casting Living End, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large army of creatures and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to search for equipment and equip it for a low cost. By taking advantage of the cheap equip costs and abilities of these cards, the deck can create powerful attacking threats that can end the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes some control elements like Esper Sentinel to disrupt the opponent's plans while setting up the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board and apply pressure to the opponent through a combination of efficient removal spells, disruptive counterspells, and evasive threats. By leveraging cards like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to maintain aggression while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent serve as key threats that can quickly close out the game if left unchecked. Overall, the deck prioritizes tempo and proactive plays to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Aggro-Death's Shadow deck is to aggressively lower your own life total to enable the powerful Death's Shadow creature, while utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Sign in Blood to reach that goal quickly. The deck also focuses on disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while generating value through cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. By efficiently managing your life total and employing a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cycling creatures like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Curator of Mysteries to quickly fill the graveyard and set up for a decisive Living End combo. Violent Outburst and Force of Negation help ensure the combo resolves successfully, while cards like Grief and Shardless Agent provide disruption and card advantage. The deck also includes a few larger creatures like Waker of Waves and Colossal Skyturtle to help close out the game if necessary. The goal is to efficiently cycle through the deck, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and combo off for a game-winning Living End.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a variety of aggressive creatures and burn spells, supported by strong mana-fixing from the lands and the companion Jegantha. The deck is focused on maintaining a fast pace and applying pressure early on to put the opponent on the back foot. With a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf, along with efficient removal and counter spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial, this deck is designed to dominate the early game and secure a swift victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's strategy while dealing damage. With efficient removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, as well as hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Dauthi Voidwalker provide extra resilience and versatility to the deck, allowing for different paths to victory.

This deck focuses on using creatures to tutor out specific combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling to search for key creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The creatures in the deck also provide value on their own, with recursive threats like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf. The deck aims to assemble a synergistic board state that can overwhelm the opponent with efficient creature plays and combo interactions.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck also includes various utility cards such as Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to help find the Tron pieces. The deck utilizes powerful Planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the game and threats like Sundering Titan and Eldrazi creatures to close out the game. Additionally, the deck has access to a sideboard transformation plan with Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing decks with artifacts.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating value and potentially winning the game in one explosive turn. It includes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to fuel the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption while cards like Consider and Expressive Iteration help to dig for combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and attacks.

This deck aims to control the game by assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana. The key strategy revolves around using powerful colorless threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Karn Liberated to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Various utility cards and planeswalkers provide additional flexibility and answers to different situations, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring offers a unique resource to further enhance the deck's capabilities. By efficiently ramping into massive threats, the deck aims to overpower the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to equip creatures with Colossus Hammer and other powerful equipment quickly and efficiently, while utilizing Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and cheat equipment onto the battlefield. The deck aims to create explosive turns where creatures become huge threats with evasion, leading to fast and efficient victories. By utilizing cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga, the deck can establish a powerful board presence and overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to respond.

The concept of this UB Mill deck is to slowly chip away at the opponent's library by using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, Fractured Sanity, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to mill cards from the top of their deck. The goal is to fill their graveyard quickly to enable Archive Trap, a powerful mill spell that can deal a significant amount of damage in one turn. The deck also includes interaction and disruption with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Surgical Extraction, Path to Exile, and Spell Pierce to control the flow of the game.

This deck focuses on using cheap spells to control the board while quickly deploying threats to pressure the opponent. By playing efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration allows for consistent card draw and selection, ensuring the deck can keep up with the opponent's plays while maintaining a steady stream of threats.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cheat Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play using Goryo's Vengeance and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The Underworld Cookbook serves as card draw and discard outlet, while Yargle and Multani can provide early aggression. Thoughtseize and Profane Tutor help find the necessary combo pieces, with Cragganwick Cremator serving as a secondary win condition. The deck utilizes a mix of black, red, and green mana sources to support its game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Hardened Scales to increase the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures like Hangarback Walker, Walking Ballista, and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. By maximizing the number of counters on these creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Arcbound Ravager and The Ozolith allows for additional ways to move counters around and create explosive turns. With Urza's Saga providing additional versatility and card advantage, this deck is built to be aggressive and efficient in its strategy.
